title: Certificate Of Analysis
description: Certificate Of Analysis contract normalized from the DocuBricks Manufacturing library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: docubricks-manufacturing-certificate-of-analysis
  title: Certificate Of Analysis
  description: Certificate Of Analysis contract normalized from the DocuBricks Manufacturing library.
  version: manufacturing_certificate_of_analysis_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: manufacturing/certificate_of_analysis
    sourcePath: Schemas/manufacturing/certificate_of_analysis
    sourceVersion: manufacturing_certificate_of_analysis_v1
    sourceDigest: 9d1e03fb66f523cf5c3d46e94c9a8f3e642a5e7f7bd40051edda2a70a715d370
spec:
  documentType: certificate_of_analysis
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - certificate-date
        - expiration-date
        - manufacture-date
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - authorized-signer
        - certificate-number
        - specification-standard
        - test-results
    - id: parties
      title: Parties
      description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - material-name
        - supplier-name
    - id: property-or-asset
      title: Property Or Asset
      description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - lot-number
        - part-or-material-number
    - id: risk-and-compliance
      title: Risk And Compliance
      description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - coa-disposition
  fields:
    - id: certificate-number
      name: certificate_number
      label: Certificate Number
      description: Certificate of analysis number.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/certificate_number
    - id: certificate-date
      name: certificate_date
      label: Certificate Date
      description: Certificate date.
      dataType: date
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/certificate_date
    - id: supplier-name
      name: supplier_name
      label: Supplier Name
      description: Supplier or manufacturer.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/supplier_name
    - id: material-name
      name: material_name
      label: Material Name
      description: Material or product name.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/material_name
    - id: part-or-material-number
      name: part_or_material_number
      label: Part Or Material Number
      description: Part, material, or item number.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/part_or_material_number
    - id: lot-number
      name: lot_number
      label: Lot Number
      description: Lot, batch, heat, or serial number.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/lot_number
    - id: specification-standard
      name: specification_standard
      label: Specification Standard
      description: Specification or standard referenced.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/specification_standard
    - id: test-results
      name: test_results
      label: Test Results
      description: Test results with analyte or characteristic, method, result, unit, and limit.
      dataType: array
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/test_results
    - id: manufacture-date
      name: manufacture_date
      label: Manufacture Date
      description: Manufacture date.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/manufacture_date
    - id: expiration-date
      name: expiration_date
      label: Expiration Date
      description: Expiration or retest date.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/expiration_date
    - id: authorized-signer
      name: authorized_signer
      label: Authorized Signer
      description: Authorized signer.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/authorized_signer
    - id: coa-disposition
      name: coa_disposition
      label: Coa Disposition
      description: Conforms, accepted, rejected, or other disposition.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/coa_disposition
  validationRules:
    - id: certificate-number-present
      severity: error
      description: certificate_number is required for Certificate of Analysis extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: certificate_number
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: certificate_number
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: certificate_number IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(certificate_number)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: certificate-date-present
      severity: error
      description: certificate_date is required for Certificate of Analysis extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: certificate_date
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: certificate_date
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: certificate_date IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(certificate_date)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: supplier-name-present
      severity: error
      description: supplier_name is required for Certificate of Analysis extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: supplier_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: supplier_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: supplier_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(supplier_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: material-name-present
      severity: error
      description: material_name is required for Certificate of Analysis extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: material_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: material_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: material_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(material_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: lot-number-present
      severity: error
      description: lot_number is required for Certificate of Analysis extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: lot_number
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: lot_number
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: lot_number IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(lot_number)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: test-results-present
      severity: error
      description: test_results is required for Certificate of Analysis extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: test_results
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: test_results
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: test_results IS NOT NULL AND JSON_ARRAY_LENGTH(test_results) > 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      certificate_number:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Certificate of Analysis workflow.
      supplier_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Certificate of Analysis workflow.
      lot_number:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Certificate of Analysis workflow.
      test_results:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Certificate of Analysis workflow.
      certificate_date:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Required field for Certificate of analysis extraction.
      material_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Required field for Certificate of analysis extraction.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Certificate of Analysis documents combine manufacturing, quality, supplier, material, and
      operational control context.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      certificate_number:
        type: string
        description: Certificate of analysis number.
      certificate_date:
        type: date
        description: Certificate date.
        format: date
      supplier_name:
        type: string
        description: Supplier or manufacturer.
      material_name:
        type: string
        description: Material or product name.
      part_or_material_number:
        type: string
        description: Part, material, or item number.
      lot_number:
        type: string
        description: Lot, batch, heat, or serial number.
      specification_standard:
        type: string
        description: Specification or standard referenced.
      test_results:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          properties:
            characteristic:
              type: string
              description: Tested analyte or characteristic.
            method:
              type: string
              description: Test method.
            result:
              type: string
              description: Reported result.
            unit:
              type: string
              description: Result unit.
            limit:
              type: string
              description: Specification limit.
        description: Test results with analyte or characteristic, method, result, unit, and limit.
      manufacture_date:
        type: date
        description: Manufacture date.
        format: date
      expiration_date:
        type: date
        description: Expiration or retest date.
        format: date
      authorized_signer:
        type: string
        description: Authorized signer.
      coa_disposition:
        type: string
        description: Conforms, accepted, rejected, or other disposition.
    required:
      - certificate_number
      - certificate_date
      - supplier_name
      - material_name
      - lot_number
      - test_results
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: manufacturing_quality
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - certificate_number
          - certificate_date
          - supplier_name
          - material_name
          - lot_number
          - test_results
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - parties
          - property_or_asset
          - risk_and_compliance
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields:
          - test_results
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
